definition: Except if; should it not happen that.
exampleSentence: You will not pass the theoretical module unless you revise thoroughly.

definition: The way a thing turns out; a consequence.
exampleSentence: If we invest in solar panels, the environmental outcome will improve.
If I had a private jet, I would travel to distant islands.

definition: The state of something with regard to its appearance or quality.
exampleSentence: Plants grow rapidly provided that soil conditions are optimal.

definition: A thing that may happen or be the case.
exampleSentence: If they offer me the internship, I will accept without hesitation.

definition: A result or effect of an action or condition.
exampleSentence: Missing two lessons carries the direct consequence of extra homework.

definition: On the condition or understanding that.
exampleSentence: We can go sailing tomorrow provided that the wind remains calm.

definition: Assume that something is true for the sake of argument.
exampleSentence: Suppose you won a scholarship; which university would you select?

definition: A set of circumstances in which one finds oneself.
exampleSentence: A calm approach is essential when handling an unexpected situation.

definition: Say or estimate that a specified thing will happen in the future.
exampleSentence: It is difficult to predict how the trade negotiations will unfold.
